patterns: Separate application/enrollment fees from tuition or programme fees.
Keep the billing unit with each amount: per inquiry, rotation, block or month.
Store stipends/salary under funding or compensation, not tuition; state the purpose when published.
A fellowship label alone does not establish whether it charges tuition or pays a stipend.
summary.comparability: Amounts are not comparable across categories or billing periods. Preserve the source wording; set currency_code to null when a page shows only '$' and does not state the currency. Unknown values remain null.
